title: PNP sounds alarm over online posts of students carrying firearms
summary: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police urged the public to use social media responsibly following separate incidents in Sultan Kudarat and South Cotabato involving students and alleged…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police urged the public to use social media responsibly following separate incidents in Sultan Kudarat and South Cotabato involving students and alleged firearm-related online posts. “Let this be a reminder that social media is not a place to make threats or create fear,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. in a statement on Monday. “Kahit online ginawa ang isang post, hindi ibig sabihin na wala itong epekto sa totoong buhay,” he added. (“Just because a post was made online, it doesn’t mean it has no real-life impact.”) READ: Sultan Kudarat cops question 13-year-old over school […]...
